in_arabic.name: سليمان
in_arabic.meaning: سليمان يعني السلام والأمن والكمال في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: سليمان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة سلم، ويعني السلام والأمن والكمال في الحياة. ورد اسم سليمان في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، سورة آل عمران، سورة النمل، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة عند الله تعالى. يرمز الاسم إلى السلام والرخاء والنجاح في الحياة، ويحمل معاني الهداية والرشاد.

in_urdu.name: سلیمان
in_urdu.meaning: سلیمان کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور امنیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: سلیمان ایک مشہور نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور امنیت۔ قرآن مجید میں سلیمان نام کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے، خاص طور پر سورة النمل میں۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت مقبول ہے اور اس کا تعلق النبی سلیمان علیہ السلام سے ہے، جو اپنی حكمت اور انصاف کے لئے جانے جاتے تھے۔

in_hindi.name: सुलैमान
in_hindi.meaning: सुलैमान का अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुलैमान एक प्रसिद्ध नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा। कुरआन में सुलैमान नाम का उल्लेख किया गया है, विशेष रूप से सूरा नुहल में। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका संबंध नबी सुलैमान से है, जो अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता और न्याय के लिए जाने जाते थे।

in_pashto.meaning: سلیمان د سولې او امنیتی معنی لري

in_english.name: Suleman
in_english.meaning: Suleman means peace, security, and prosperity
in_english.long_meaning: Suleman is a masculine given name derived from Arabic, meaning peace, security, and prosperity. The name is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran, and Surah An-Naml. It is associated with Prophet Suleman (Solomon), known for his wisdom, justice, and prophethood. The name symbolizes guidance, righteousness, and success. It is popular across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic tradition and history.

data.cultural_impact: The name Suleman is of Arabic origin and is popular in the Islamic world. It is a beautiful and poetic name that evokes a sense of comfort, solace, and peace. In many Muslim societies, the name Suleman is associated with strong and noble leaders, who are known for their compassion, wisdom, and the ability to bring peace and stability to their communities. For instance, the Prophet Solomon, who is known as Suleman in Arabic, is celebrated as a wise and just leader in the Islamic tradition. He is known for his ability to communicate with animals, his vast knowledge, and his unyielding devotion to God.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islam, the name Suleman is considered a reflection of God's mercy and compassion. The Arabic word "Suleman" is derived from the word "soulama", which means "one who gives comfort, solace, and tranquility". This name is believed to inspire peace, calmness, and a sense of security in those who bear it. It is also seen as a reminder of God's presence and protection, and the importance of seeking His comfort and guidance in times of need. The spiritual significance of the name Suleman is further enhanced by the fact that it is the name of a prophet in the Islamic tradition, Prophet Solomon, who was known for his deep faith and close relationship with God. This connection to the prophetic legacy adds an additional layer of meaning and significance to the name, encouraging those who bear it to strive for closeness to God and to emulate the virtues of wisdom, justice, and compassion.
